text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today was the Spring Fan Thanksgiving 
Festival! The Umamusume hosted a variety 
of events for the gathered fans.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, Sakura Laurel also participated 
in the events—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I had her rest in the corner of the 
outdoor stage after she returned with a 
refreshed look on her face.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. It was worth looking for an event 
where I could participate in my racing 
outfit.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
It's a special outfit I finally earned the 
right to wear. I want the fans to see it 
outside of GⅠ races too, after all♪
choice_data_list: I'm sure the fans are happy too.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I'd be glad if that's the case. Everyone 
always cheers for me, so I wanted to give 
something back in return.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaah~! Eeek!)

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Justice Biko Special Edition! 'A New 
Villain Appears?! A Scene from the Fan 
Thanksgiving' Here we gooo!"

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Do your best! Waaah, Justice Biko!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the stage was Biko Pegasus. If I recall 
correctly, she debuted around the same 
time as Sakura Laurel and was an Umamusume 
who took the sprint route.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my, Biko-chan is quite popular at the 
Fan Thanksgiving too, isn't she?♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Then I won't lose either—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Go get 'em, Justice Biko!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
...! Hehe. Alright, justice is gonna win 
today too!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh-heh! We'll take on that 
confidence! We are the super heels who 
will change the world!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Worldwide Windy is here!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Aaah, two on one? How cowardly~ Is this 
where the secret weapon makes its debut?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Wha-!? Doctor Tachyon, it's too early for 
you to come out—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I've been waiting for you, Tachyon! I'm 
here to completely crush you!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Waaah!? You're on stage early too!? 
Phantom Thief Naughty Pokke!?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Haha, I've got no intention of falling 
behind Tachyon! And so...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
...What was I supposed to do after 
entering the stage again?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Bring that Umamusume in the stands over 
here. Our organization leads kids down bad 
paths, but scaring them is off-limits."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Oh! 'Sup. ...Welp, later!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Hey, isn't there someone standing out 
right there! You! Come over here!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Huh!?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Wha-wha-whaaat!? Th-That hostage is—!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Y-You promised you'd bring someone in a 
school uniform, didn't you!? In a racing 
outfit, she doesn't look like a hostage at 
all!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Ugh. Ah... Then, that's it!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
You were hiding in the audience, but 
you're actually the hero's ally, aren't 
you?

text_block_list.name: Biko & Laurel
text_block_list.text: Eeeeh!?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"How's that?! That oughta turn the tide 
back in our favor, right!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
T-That's completely absurd! In the first 
place, asking Laurel-senpai out of nowhere 
to play a superhero is just...!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Biko...? You can do it! Are you okayー?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
(...! Biko's in trouble. Right, in that 
case—)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I was a hero too! I've come to the 
rescue, Justice Biko!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Huh, Laurel-senpai!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
(Squeeze it out of your brain...! A 
hero... when you think of a hero, 
it's...!)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...Heh.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"I, the Hero Shadow... ...shall devour 
everything."

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hero Shadow looks like he's got what it 
takes to be a villain, nanoda!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Well, well, well~ Is it about time for the 
secret weapon?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Waaah!? Wait, wait up!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Heh...

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha. That sounds kind of fun! Hero 
Shadow...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The hero show descended into complete 
chaos. Afterward, Biko Pegasus somehow 
managed to force things back on track 
through sheer brute strength.

text_block_list.name: Child A
text_block_list.text: Lord Hero Shadow... is so cool...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...It looks like Sakura Laurel has managed 
to gain fans through a new approach as 
well.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"Transformation power charged! Victory 
Laurel has arrived!!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
...! Laurel-senpai, what a magnificent 
hero's monologue...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, Biko-chan. Keep your head held high, 
okay?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Everyone is waiting to see you shine.

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Justice bico...? Y-You can do it!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
A hero never gives up, no matter what, and 
keeps running toward the light.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I think that's why everyone's eyes sparkle 
so bright when they look at heroes. Come 
on, now's the time to hold on tight... 
Hero!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
...! I see... If I look anxious, I'll just 
make everyone else worry too.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I've woken up, Victory Laurel! All right, 
let's fix this together!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: ...! Justice Biko! Go get 'em--!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Alright, gather everyone's cheers in your 
heart! Let's go, it's time for the 
ultimate move!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Justice!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: BEEEEAAAM!

text_block_list.name: Evil Executives
text_block_list.text: Nodaaaaaah! Ooooooh! Whoa!?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Pearl!? Whoa whoa, our match isn't—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
If we've been hit by a beam, Worldwide 
Windy must make her exit♪ Let's all leave 
in style!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Amaaazing! That was so cool!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Heheh. Thanks for all the support, 
everyone!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Even when hard times come, you'll be just 
fine. A heart that never gives up is 
always on your side!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Ready, and! Victory!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Sakura Laurel jumped into the hero 
show, receiving thunderous applause from 
the children.
